Class ExtraMove

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.Card
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.Building
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.ExtraMove
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ExtraMove extends Building
Building that grants the owner an extra card draw from the upper row at the end of the round (Trigger.END_ROUND), handled by ExtraMoveState. The bonus is stored in BuildingBonus.setExtraMove().

    • ExtraMove

      public ExtraMove(String id, int endGamePP, int cost, Trigger trigger, Set<Character> characterUse, int era, Integer numPlayers)
      Creates an ExtraMove building card.
      Parameters:
      id - unique card identifier
      endGamePP - prestige points scored at end-game for owning this building
      cost - food cost to acquire this building
      trigger - unused, reserved for future configuration of the activation trigger
      characterUse - unused, reserved for future configuration of character-based conditions
      era - the era this card belongs to (1-3)
      numPlayers - minimum number of players required for this card to be in play, or null if always included
